summary.text: Kristi Morris is a Democratic member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windsor-3 District and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gov. Phil Scott appointed Morris to the seat on June 20, 2019, to fill a vacancy created by the death of Robert Forguites.

paragraphs.text: Morris obtained an associate degree in mechanical engineering from Vermont Technical College.
Morris worked as the manager of engineering at Lovejoy Tool Company in Springfield for nearly 45 years.
Morris was assigned to the Natural Resources, Fish, and Wildlife Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
